sentences.text: I do not find any ground to pass such order looking to the fact that number of cases are pending before the trial court waiting for its logical conclusion and in the circumstances, no such direction can be issued to decide a particular case within a stipulated time.

Further, if the applicant is moves any fresh application before the court below concerned, the court below is directed to consider and decide of the application in accordance with law without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties as expeditiously as possible.
4. With the aforesaid, the present application stands disposed of.
